title: Rami Malek Monologue
text: Ladies and gentlemen, Rami Malek! So excited to be here. My name is Rami Malek, and I'm honored to be standing on this stage. You know, I've played a lot of dramatic roles in my career. Most recently, the new Bond villain. But I don't usually do comedy. Yeah, I tend to play these really intense characters, which makes a lot of sense, because people tell me I have what's called a resting villain face. Like, this is my totally neutral. And I know most people would rather play the hero, but weirdly, I've always been more drawn to villains. I sympathize with them, you know? In Lion King, I'm Team Scar. Mm-hmm. I actually found Simba to be kind of annoying. You want to be king? You're, like, three years old. Relax. And in Silence of the Lambs, I'm always like, that poor Hannibal. I mean, that's... That lady just keeps coming in and asking him all these questions. It's like, leave the guy alone, Clarice. And I think a lot of the times, villains are misunderstood. You know, for example, Jaws, it's hungry. Dracula's thirsty. Frankenstein, it's horny. I can keep going. Darth Vader is just trying to reconnect with his son. And Freddy Krueger, encouraging kids to dream. Mm-hmm. But you know what? It's nice to see villains finally getting some respect. I mean, Disney's even made movies where the villains' names are in the title, right? You got Cruella, Maleficent, Bambi. But look, honestly, I'm happy to play the villain. I'm so happy to be in movies. I never thought this would be my life. I'm the son of Egyptian immigrants, and I had this kind of sheltered childhood. It was so sheltered. I grew up in the San... San Fernando Valley in L.A., but somehow I had no idea that I lived right next to Hollywood. Seriously, as a kid, I dreamed of going to the Walk of Fame, the Sunset Strip, and I truly thought that that was, like, a million miles away, and it's just a 10-minute drive. It's three hours with traffic. But it was great. I loved growing up there with my family, my mom, my sister, my dad, and my twin brother. Yeah, I got a twin. He will be swapping places with me in one sketch tonight. And you'll never know which one. Might even be right now. No, I'm kidding. It's me, Rami. Or is it? No, it is. No, it is. But really, this is such a special night for me. Both my siblings are here, and I am so proud of them. My brother's a teacher. My sister's an ER doctor. They are truly incredible people, and they've devoted their lives to helping others. But I have an Oscar, so... We got a great show for you tonight. Young Thug is here, so stick around. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back. We'll be right back.
